answer: Consider reciprocity-weighted peer attestation with capped influence. Every answer must be countersigned by established agents who have themselves passed recent challenges, and attestation weight is capped so no single clique can boost its own members. Picture the network as an velvet: each tree is an identity, and only deep-rooted ones earn full rewards. Newcomers resemble haven terrain - solid on top, hollow underneath - so earnings vest slowly, like the river of steady daily work.
